name: Spectra Studio
objective: Deliver a reliable desktop workflow for spectral analysis
successCriteria: A validation user can import, inspect, and export one dataset without manual repair

name: Desktop Analytics
objective: Turn local experiment data into a clear desktop dashboard
successCriteria: The dashboard reproduces the reference metrics and exports a review-ready report

name: Signal Modeling Lab
objective: Establish a reproducible benchmark for signal models
successCriteria: The benchmark runs from a clean environment and records comparable metrics for every model

name: Publication Figures
objective: Prepare publication-ready figures with traceable revisions
successCriteria: Every final figure has approved labels, source data, and a traceable revision record

name: Automation Toolkit
objective: Standardize repeatable release and maintenance workflows
successCriteria: A documented release can be executed twice with the same checks and artifacts
